_about: Quality test set for `php artisan aisa:quality-eval`. Each case is a first message; the reply is checked automatically. Checks are deliberately simple and lenient: they catch clear failures (wrong language, missing numbers, invented phone numbers, markdown, missed risk), not style. Every reply should still be read by a person. Add cases whenever a real weakness is found. 'include_any': at least one of these words must appear (case-insensitive). 'exclude': none may appear.
